name: Amanohokosaka Tenjou
original_name: 天ノ矛坂 テンジョー
source: Tenjou was [url=/c26481]Bang's[/url] former mentor and also the leader of Ikaruga before being killed by [url=/c25639]Jin[/url] in order to end the Ikaruga Civil War as quickly as possible. She was also the former wielder of the Nox Nyctores, Phoenix: Rettenjou, and passed it on to Bang before dying.
